title: Christmas greeting 2026
hook: Merry Christmas from all of us at Galvor.
caption:
Merry Christmas from all of us at Galvor.

We hope today comes with good food, a slow morning and the people you like best.

The dashboards will still be there next week. Today, close the laptop.

Warm wishes to you and your family.
alt_text: Festival card in Galvor violet and gold with a Christmas tree motif. It reads Merry Christmas, then: good food, slow mornings and your favourite people. Below: from all of us at Galvor.

slides.headline: Good food, slow mornings and *your favourite people*.
slides.sub: From all of us at Galvor.
